title: Towards Stable Test-Time Adaptation in Dynamic Wild World (SAR)
mechanism: Entropy minimisation runs only on reliable low-entropy samples, with a sharpness-aware update and a model reset on collapse; designed for batch size 1 and mixed shifts.
adaptation: Batch-1 per cell on E1 with BN affine parameters, a per-pixel reliability mask and a collapse reset. It is the entropy-family baseline for the benchmark.
min_experiment: Arm: SAR on FINAL/SUP100-PF. Baseline: no TTA. Benchmark row; report the E1 and test deltas.
evidence: R: stable on ImageNet-C with batch 1, mixed shifts and label shift, where Tent collapses.
prior_overlap: None run. BN-statistics TTA failed (T9), but entropy updates of BN affine parameters were never run.
